mapper.select:
select p.paper_id as "paperId", p.paper_name as "paperName", q.question_id as "questionId", q.question_no as "questionNo", q.full_score as "fullScore" from spas_paper_question q join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = q.paper_id where not exists (select 1 from spas_question_knowledge qk where qk.question_id = q.question_id)
order by p.paper_id, q.question_order limit 200

select p.paper_id as "paperId", p.paper_name as "paperName", q.question_id as "questionId", q.question_no as "questionNo", q.full_score as "fullScore" from spas_paper_question q join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = q.paper_id where nullif(trim(q.question_type), '') is null
order by p.paper_id, q.question_order limit 200

select p.paper_id as "paperId", p.paper_name as "paperName", q.question_id as "questionId", q.question_no as "questionNo", q.full_score as "fullScore" from spas_paper_question q join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = q.paper_id where nullif(trim(q.bloom_level), '') is null
order by p.paper_id, q.question_order limit 200

select p.paper_id as "paperId", p.paper_name as "paperName", q.question_id as "questionId", q.question_no as "questionNo", coalesce(sum(qk.weight),0) as "weightSum" from spas_paper_question q join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = q.paper_id left join spas_question_knowledge qk on qk.question_id = q.question_id where 1=1
group by p.paper_id, p.paper_name, q.question_id, q.question_no, q.question_order having abs(coalesce(sum(qk.weight),0) - 1) > 0.0001 order by p.paper_id, q.question_order limit 200

select s.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", st.knowledge_id as "knowledgeId", k.knowledge_name as "knowledgeName", st.attempt_count as "attemptCount", st.weighted_rate as "weightedRate", st.weak_level as "weakLevel" from spas_student_knowledge_stat st join spas_student s on s.student_id = st.student_id and s.del_flag = '0' left join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = st.knowledge_id where st.attempt_count < #{minAttempts}
and st.subject_id = #{subjectId} order by st.attempt_count asc, s.student_no limit 200

select s.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", st.knowledge_id as "knowledgeId", k.knowledge_name as "knowledgeName", st.attempt_count as "attemptCount", st.weighted_rate as "weightedRate", st.weak_level as "weakLevel" from spas_student_knowledge_stat st join spas_student s on s.student_id = st.student_id and s.del_flag = '0' left join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = st.knowledge_id where st.attempt_count < #{minAttempts} and st.weak_level in ('1', '2', '3')
and st.subject_id = #{subjectId} order by st.weak_level desc, st.attempt_count asc, s.student_no limit 200

select p.paper_id as "paperId", p.paper_name as "paperName", p.subject_id as "subjectId", p.status as "status", p.create_time as "createTime" from spas_paper p where p.exam_date is null
order by p.paper_id desc limit 200

select d.paper_id as "paperId", p.paper_name as "paperName", d.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", count(d.detail_id) as "answered", (select count(*) from spas_paper_question q where q.paper_id = d.paper_id) as "totalQuestions" from spas_score_detail d join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = d.paper_id join spas_student s on s.student_id = d.student_id and s.del_flag = '0' where 1=1
group by d.paper_id, p.paper_name, d.student_id, s.student_no, s.student_name having count(d.detail_id) < (select count(*) from spas_paper_question q where q.paper_id = d.paper_id) order by d.paper_id desc limit 200

select d.detail_id as "detailId", d.paper_id as "paperId", p.paper_name as "paperName", p.status as "status", d.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", d.question_id as "questionId", d.score as "score" from spas_score_detail d left join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = d.paper_id join spas_student s on s.student_id = d.student_id and s.del_flag = '0' where (p.paper_id is null or p.status = '0')
and (p.subject_id = #{subjectId} or p.paper_id is null)
order by d.detail_id desc limit 200

select d.paper_id as "paperId", p.paper_name as "paperName", d.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", d.question_id as "questionId", q.question_no as "questionNo", d.score as "score", d.full_score as "fullScore", d.score_source as "scoreSource" from spas_score_detail d join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = d.paper_id join spas_student s on s.student_id = d.student_id and s.del_flag = '0' left join spas_paper_question q on q.question_id = d.question_id where ( d.score_source = '3' or ( coalesce(d.score_source, '2') <> '3' and d.score = 0 and exists ( select 1 from spas_score_detail d2 where d2.paper_id = d.paper_id and d2.student_id = d.student_id and d2.score > 0 ) ) )
order by d.paper_id desc, s.student_no limit 200

select f.knowledge_id as "knowledgeId", k.knowledge_name as "knowledgeName", f.question_count as "questionCount", m.avg_rate as "avgRate", m.student_count as "studentCount", m.attempt_avg as "attemptAvg" from ( select k.knowledge_id, count(distinct q.question_id)::int as question_count from spas_knowledge k join spas_question_knowledge qk on qk.knowledge_id = k.knowledge_id join spas_paper_question q on q.question_id = qk.question_id join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = q.paper_id where coalesce(k.node_type, '2') = '2'
group by k.knowledge_id having count(distinct q.question_id) >= #{questionMin} ) f join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = f.knowledge_id join ( select st.knowledge_id, avg(st.weighted_rate) as avg_rate, count(distinct st.student_id)::int as student_count, avg(st.attempt_count::numeric) as attempt_avg from spas_student_knowledge_stat st join spas_student s on s.student_id = st.student_id and s.del_flag = '0' where 1=1
and st.subject_id = #{subjectId} group by st.knowledge_id having avg(st.weighted_rate) < #{weakRate} ) m on m.knowledge_id = f.knowledge_id order by f.question_count desc, m.avg_rate asc limit 200
